markers.title: Almaty, Kazakhstan
markers.description: My hometown, the largest city in Kazakhstan nestled at the foot of the Tian Shan mountains. Known for its apples, beautiful nature, and as the former capital.

markers.title: Caltech, Pasadena
markers.description: California Institute of Technology - where I'm pursuing my studies in Physics. A place of incredible scientific discovery and innovation.

markers.title: Griffith Observatory
markers.description: One of my favorite places in LA. Amazing views of the city and great for stargazing. A perfect blend of science and beauty.

markers.title: Princeton University
